title: Use only registered health practitioners
what: Doctors (and other registered health professionals) working in the practice must be registered under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law, through Ahpra and the Medical Board of Australia.

sources.title: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (Queensland)
sources.quote: take or use a title in the Table to this section, in a way that could be reasonably expected to induce a belief the person is registered under this Law in the health profession listed beside the title in the Table, unless the person is registered in the profession

reach.note: Calibration: GP practices; other health classes follow in phase D. Registration attaches to each practitioner.
